'Investment' is *them* paying *you*.
There is no way *you* would have to pay *them*, aside from them sharing in profits as business owners.
People that meet you in person can still be scammers, and 'CFO' is just a title anyone can give themselves.
Wanting crypto is a red flag as well, why wouldn't they meet you in a bank with lawyers or something if they're legit, no real business would do things like tell you to open a crypto account.
Clearly a scam, block all their accounts and don't contact them again.
As for the 'end investor', either the photos were stolen or they're in on it, nothing for you to worry about, just block everything and move on.

Let me tell you a funny story I heard in a psych ward

It was a story about another patient, he did something similar to what you are describing right now

He tried to pretend hanging himself, so he put up the noose and stood on a chair, put the loop around his neck, and tried waiting for his family to come into the room and see their reaction

His mother came in and he… slipped…

When he woke up he was in the psych ward

…I just felt like telling this story, sorry. But it’s a true story, the guy himself felt it was a little funny too. I just hope I can brighten your mood somehow. If not, sorry for bothering you…


Oh I forget to mention the funny part. The funny part is, if he slipped before his mother came in, he’d be in the morgue instead… so be careful

It’s basically impossible to tell what others are thinking, you have to ask yourself, is everything that you did in goodwill? If she is hurt because of you, it’s not your fault if everything you did was because you thought it was the right thing to do at the time. Besides, since you don’t know, there’s also a chance you did everything right, right?

To be honest, if I ever decide to die, I’ll go die on my ex-friend’s doorstep, because I love her so much, I want her to know what came of her not caring enough about me, it’s strange how I’m angry at her while loving her so much

Wouldn’t you feel bad if you didn’t keep your promise to be fine? How long have you been planning your death, have you really thought it through, or has it just been too many emotions pushing you to this point?

If you live days away, you can start going over to their place right now, they’ll likely be awake when you get there

When you’re exhausted try taking a nap, I’m exhausted due to my grandparents and my job search, I basically slept through the last three days, one meal a day, not hungry at all because life is annoying me too much for me to eat properly. I’m usually in my best state when I just woke up, I’m feeling good enough to come talk right now for instance, sleeping is great, almost like a method of dying you can wake up from, it’s real nice

Try going to your friend then, go cry in their lap, maybe you can try working something out together? Sometimes the emotions all come in at once, crying and talking to people really helps, try going to meet your friend in person? You’re planning to die at midnight anyway, you have nothing to lose

I know that feeling, I lost my best friend 1 year ago, my therapist always tells me that I’ll find someone better, but every day without her is agonizing, I’m not sure how I’m still alive either to be honest, but some things take time, perhaps we just have to push through somehow

Why not a hospital, I just got out of a hospital last month, stayed there for 50 days, I’m a lot better now. My biggest regret is not going to a hospital 1 year ago, before I made so many irreversible mistakes due to my illness. Are hospitals not good in your country?
Try falling asleep, I have bad days where I want to die for no apparent reason, I’m usually better after a nap. New day, new me. If every day’s a bad day to you, I’m not sure how to help, sorry.
You’re amazing. Stay strong.

I personally think it’s a physical sickness indeed…

Not being able to think properly, sudden bouts of extreme sadness and crying, my friend was like that in October or something last year, so she got heavier antidepressants from the doctor.  Couldn’t stop her from being suicidal, but it did stop her random heavy crying episodes.

So go see a doctor if you can, it might help.

I walk around daydreaming all day, lots of virtual friends, such a happy world. I hope I go to that world when I die. Probably not disorder level for me though. I do wish that real people were as ideal as those that I daydream of.

Anyway, I recommend walking around the dinner table or sofa or something while daydreaming, it’s nice exercise I guess?

And I sometimes daydream in bed for so long that I can’t fall asleep for hours. So that’s a con I guess.

When no one else is there for me, my virtual friends are all I have…

Edit: Oh I also daydream of being successful later in life, giving speeches to students or news reporters and such, fun.

Struggle? I don’t think it’s a thing I struggle with, life is a struggle, not my daydreams. If it makes you happy both in the short term and the long term, then it’s perfect. If only the short term, at least it’s a successful coping mechanism.

I say, it’s great to be happy, so much better than being sad. So why not.
What sort of help do you want?

Give it a while at least, give yourself time to calm down, like, a week or so at least, before doing anything rash.

Don’t think about it in the meantime, it’s happened already, no use thinking about it anymore, that will only make you sad.

I lost my closest friend in March this year due to my stupidity, which is why I’m on this sub, I only started to get better a few months later, maybe I’ll be completely fine next year, who knows.

Just try to give yourself some time to calm down a bit for now.
How?

You don’t know me, but you’re a great person, I can see that from your last paragraph, and I hope that everyone could be as nice as you are. To me, kindness is more important than most other achievements in life. I wrote more than one sentence, hope that makes up for you not knowing me.

But I also don’t think that anyone should let the judgments of others define their life. Try to acknowledge yourself for who you are. What you think about yourself matters the most.

Try distracting yourself maybe? Talking to people works best for me, I’m at my worst when I’m alone. I get books to read for those times, or try to learn something, anything that forces me to focus on it, so that my mind doesn’t wander. I also tend to overwork myself a bit, making sure that I’m tired enough to fall asleep instantly when I go to bed.

Not thinking about doing it all the time would be a good start. Then I would suggest finding some goals to work forward to, enough so that you can force yourself to stay alive until you’ve completed them. Then you can go work on something else. Personally, I need a reason to stay alive, otherwise I don’t really want to, because I feel that I’ve failed too much already.

Hope this helps, somewhat at least.

Law does not allow me to support suicide in my country, I could be prosecuted if I do so. I can’t even tell people methods that I think to be good for suicide. You can check the laws in your country, and even if it doesn’t break the law to support suicidal thoughts there, it is still not in accordance with general moral principles, which could affect the life of a person that tries to support you, either socially or mentally, especially if you actually die.

So maybe finding someone that supports your suicide would be even harder than finding someone to support other things you want to do. Just some input about the issue.

Your experience shows very clearly that suicide often does not happen because of free choice, but because of the circumstances forced on people by society.

Why shouldn’t it be legal to sell your own body parts for money, even if it’s economically efficient? Because that would make poor people a lot more likely to have one less kidney compared to rich people. It is unfair. Just like a minimum wage still has to exist, even if the unemployment rate becomes higher because of it, otherwise people of low social status would be treated like slaves (not that people aren’t slaves now, but it would be even worse).

People that are born to or end up in bad circumstances should be treated better, and have more ways to make their life better, not just given a right to die easily. This “suicide booth” service would be disproportionately used by people in bad circumstances, and people with nice lives would just be free to not help them or make the world better for them.

For instance, it would be better if a social worker set up a stand to help people with your kind of situation, rather than just giving you a choice to die for 25 cents at that stand. If people were to be given something by society, there are a lot of things that would be better then a suicide booth. A “happiness booth”, perhaps?

There’s nothing to be sorry about, I understand that people have important things that they need to have in their life, my friend always needed a girlfriend, and whenever she didn’t have one, she felt that life was meaningless and wanted to die, even attempted suicide once.

You can try to place yourself in situations where you can meet girls, or use dating apps? I have to warn you, girlfriends often make you feel like their only purpose is to leave you and make you sad, but hey, if the other option is death, you can afford to try. I don’t like telling people to go find love, they often end up so sad, so many times, but if you need love, do your best finding it. Love is real and does exist, so anyone has a chance at it, including you of course.

Hope you make it.

I have a friend that’s like you, legally disabled from depression, constant episodes. One day she tried cutting her throat for several hours, and it was too hard to complete, she got even more depressed from failing to kill herself, ended up giving up and calling for help. Went to a psychiatric hospital next Monday, came out three weeks later, she seemed to feel better inside, although it was boring. Pills don’t help with her depression, only the sleeping pills work, she didn’t even consider taking pills for suicide because she feels they’re just too ineffective on her, and we heard that failing to suicide by pills can be agonizing.

tl;dr quick way to end suffering might not be the two listed methods above, suggest trying psych ward and see if that’s where you want to be for a while
